$comment: Company data fields (founder 2026-10-07; spec pages + identifier widening 2026-10-08): the typed company-level data values the repo genuinely consumes. Honest derivation rule, widened once and deliberately for the identifier fields: a field exists here only because a committed open-artifacts/registry.json artifact establishes it (producedBy) AND one of two committed consumption paths is real - (a) a committed lib/openstartup exported function takes it (signatures read from the module source; consumedBy names the real exported function and the parameter/property the value enters as), OR (b) a committed corpus process requires-and-carries it: the establishing artifact sits in the requires list of committed open-processes/corpus.json records, which consume the value through the artifact (the EIN entered on the bank KYC and payroll setup, the Delaware file number the annual-report portal keys on). Path-(b) fields carry no consumedBy; their consuming processes are computed from the corpus requires edges, never hand-listed. Never speculative either way. Each field also carries its spec (founder 2026-10-08): format sentence, regex pattern where the authority's format is strict, the authority's own documented example where one exists (never an invented number), the assigning/defining authority, the documents the value appears on, and URL citations for the format claims (every URL fetch-verified when curated). Totality is tested in lib/__tests__/companyFields.test.ts; read back by lib/companyFields.ts; rendered on /fields and /fields/[id], on /artifacts/[id] (Data fields this artifact establishes) and /open-modules/[id] (fields the module consumes). Schema: schemas/company-fields.schema.json. Geo dimension (founder field-standards order, landed with the open-artifacts/ move 2026-10-14): each field carries `geo` - the universal form (scope: universal) for values set by the company's own records (the same field in every covered country), or a base US instance (label, authority, pattern where the authority documents the format, authority-page sources) plus one entry per covered country (UK/IN/DE/FR/PT/CA), each a government-defined equivalent instance or a recorded absence (no-equivalent / unverified, with the reason and citations where the absence itself is documented). Equivalent sources were fetch-verified when curated or reused from committed corpus geoNote actionUrls (already fetch-verified at corpus curation); bot-walled authorities (mca.gov.in, incometaxindia.gov.in) are documented in the entries they blocked. Totality and pattern/example coherence are vitest-gated in lib/__tests__/companyFields.test.ts; zod source: CompanyFieldGeoSchema in lib/companyFields.ts.

fields.label: Date of incorporation

fields.label: Fiscal year end
fields.description: The company's tax-year end - declared on the SS-4 when the EIN is obtained (calendar-year December 31 for most startups); it positions the federal return deadline.

spec.format: A calendar date; the open modules consume it as an ISO YYYY-MM-DD string (the committed wire contract in lib/openstartup/deadlines.ts).
spec.authority: Declared by the company to the IRS: Form SS-4 line 12 asks for the closing month of the accounting year, and the Form 1120 return covers that tax year.
whereItAppears: Form SS-4 line 12 (closing month of accounting year)
The Form 1120 header (the tax year the return covers)

base.label: Tax year end (Form SS-4 line 12 / Form 1120)
base.summary: Declared by the company: Form SS-4 line 12 asks for the closing month of the accounting year, and the Form 1120 return covers that tax year.

equivalents.label: Accounting reference date
equivalents.summary: The company's financial year runs to its accounting reference date, changeable at Companies House: shorten as often as wanted, lengthen to at most 18 months once every 5 years, and never while accounts are overdue.

sources.label: GOV.UK, Change your company's year end

equivalents.label: Financial year (April to March)
equivalents.summary: The tax year runs April to March rather than the calendar year; the company's ITR-6 return covers it.

equivalents.label: Wirtschaftsjahr
equivalents.summary: Profit is determined by the Wirtschaftsjahr the company regularly closes accounts for; switching to a year deviating from the calendar year is effective for tax only in agreement with the Finanzamt (KStG section 7(4)).

equivalents.note: The closing date of the exercice comptable is set in the statuts and the IS declaration covers it, but a government page documenting the year-end rule was not fetch-verified when curated.
The IRC periodo de tributacao defaults to the calendar year with an option to differ, but a government page documenting the rule was not fetch-verified when curated.

equivalents.label: Tax year (fiscal period)
equivalents.summary: A new corporation chooses its tax year-end with its first T2 return (lines 060 and 061); a fiscal period cannot be longer than 53 weeks (371 days).

sources.label: CRA T2 Corporation Income Tax Guide, chapter 1 (tax year)

equivalents.label: Business year (사업연도)
equivalents.summary: The business year is one accounting period fixed by statute or the articles of incorporation, capped at one year; a corporation without one declares it together with its incorporation report or business registration (Corporate Tax Act Article 6).

sources.label: Corporate Tax Act Article 6 (law.go.kr, Korean original)

fields.label: Founder stock transfer date

Form 15620 box 3 (the date the property is transferred)

base.label: Date of transfer (Form 15620 box 3)

equivalents.label: Date of acquisition (section 431 election window)
equivalents.summary: The analog date: the joint section 431 ITEPA election on restricted shares must be made within 14 days of acquisition, so the acquisition date plays the role the transfer date plays for the 83(b).

equivalents.note: No 83(b)-style election window runs from a transfer date: founder vesting is contractual, and share awards are taxed as a perquisite under their own rules.
No election window runs from a transfer date; the statutory lever for startup equity is EStG section 19a deferred taxation, not a filing-deadline race.

equivalents.note: No equivalent election date: founder and employee equity are taxed under the BOFiP-governed regimes (BSPCE, free shares), with no deadline running from transfer.

No election deadline runs from the transfer date: founder shares issue at nominal value with CCPC tax deferral.
No committed rule in this country consumes a founder stock-transfer date the way the 83(b) election window does; there is no election clock to race.

equivalents.label: Company registration number (CRN)
equivalents.summary: Companies House allocates the registered number at incorporation; the certificate of incorporation states the name and registered number of the company. The fetched guidance documents no character format, so no pattern is recorded.

sources.label: Companies House guidance, Incorporation and names

equivalents.note: The Registrar of Companies allots a Corporate Identity Number (CIN) on the SPICe+ incorporation, but mca.gov.in was bot-walled when curated, so the instance could not be verified against the authority's own page.

equivalents.label: Handelsregisternummer (HRA/HRB)
equivalents.summary: The register court assigns the HRB (or HRA) number when the company registers in the Handelsregister; the joint register portal of the Laender serves every Bundesland's registers. No nationwide format is documented, so no pattern is recorded.

equivalents.label: SIREN (RCS registration)
equivalents.summary: The nine-digit SIREN is the company's registration identifier: INSEE allots it when the guichet unique registration lands, and the RCS entry and Kbis extract carry it.

equivalents.label: NIPC (registry number)
equivalents.authority: Instituto dos Registos e do Notariado (RNPC)
equivalents.summary: The NIPC issued at incorporation is also the company's registry identifier on the certidao permanente. No format is documented on the fetched authority pages, so no pattern is recorded.

equivalents.label: Corporation number
equivalents.summary: Corporations Canada assigns the corporation number at incorporation; it appears on the Corporate Information Sheet sent on the date of incorporation (the one-time corporation key is printed right after it). No digit format is documented, so no pattern is recorded.

equivalents.note: The corporate registry certificate carries a corporate registration number (법인등록번호), but its assignment rule was not fetch-verified against a government page when curated.
